name: Bitter Smile.
source:
Yuu returns to his hometown after being away for many years and meets the Todoroki sisters, who run a takoyaki shop named Senju. He ends up living on the 2nd floor of the shop with them. 

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/06/01/june-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
优阔别多年后回到故乡，与经营章鱼烧店"千寿"的轰姐妹重逢。最后，他与姐妹二人一起住进了店铺二楼。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/06/01/june-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
